Samplepop — CRM Monitoring & Error Tracking System

I built a custom CRM Monitoring and Error Tracking System in Zoho Creator to provide centralized visibility into the health and execution of CRM automations across multiple Zoho One accounts. The system monitors CRM workflows, custom functions, integrations, and automated processes, capturing execution data in a centralized monitoring environment. Each monitored event can include the client environment, source system, function or workflow name, execution result, related CRM record, timestamp, error details, and diagnostic information returned by Zoho or external integrations.

A key part of the system is failure monitoring and diagnostics. When an automation fails, the monitoring layer captures the relevant troubleshooting context rather than relying only on standard CRM execution logs. This makes it easier to identify exactly which automation failed, which CRM record was affected, what operation was being performed, and what error response was returned.

The dashboard provides visibility into automation health, failure trends, recurring errors, affected records, and problematic functions or workflows. This allows us to identify patterns across executions, prioritize recurring issues, and investigate individual failures without having to manually review multiple CRM workflow and function logs.

The monitoring architecture was also designed as a multi-client system. Each client's Zoho environment can report monitoring events into a centralized monitoring platform while maintaining client-specific dashboards and views. This provides a consistent monitoring framework across multiple CRM implementations while keeping each client's operational data clearly separated.

The project combines Zoho Creator, Zoho CRM, Deluge, API integrations, structured error logging, automation monitoring, failure detection, diagnostic data collection, and monitoring dashboards. It is an active project, so I can share a working example of the system and demonstrate how CRM automations are monitored in practice.

Integrity Roofing & Painting — Roofing Estimator & Proposal Automation

I developed a custom Estimator Assistant in Zoho Creator for Integrity Roofing & Painting, a roofing contractor based in Colorado. The application was designed to help their estimating team create accurate roofing estimates and proposals faster, while reducing manual calculations and maintaining centralized pricing and product information.

The solution integrated Zoho Creator, Zoho CRM, EagleView, and Zoho Sign, covering most of the estimating process from initial job information through the final customer proposal and signature.

The estimator entered the job details, scope of work, accessories, and material quality. From there, the application automatically handled most of the estimating calculations.

Roof Templates stored in Zoho CRM defined the required materials and components for different types of roofing jobs. Zoho Creator retrieved the appropriate template and used it as the foundation for each estimate.

EagleView integration provided detailed roof measurements. The application used these measurements to calculate roof area, required material quantities, and waste factors, applying the appropriate percentage based on the project requirements.

All material and labor pricing remained centralized in Zoho CRM, eliminating the need for estimators to maintain pricing separately inside Creator. The application combined EagleView measurements, CRM roof templates, current material pricing, labor rates, waste calculations, local taxes, and selected options to calculate material and labor costs for each component of the project.

Estimators could generate three proposal options with different material quality levels, allowing customers to compare alternatives. Zoho Creator then automatically created the corresponding Quotes in Zoho CRM, where they could be merged into a professional proposal, delivered to the customer, and electronically signed through Zoho Sign.

The application covered nearly the entire estimating workflow: job information, roof measurements, materials, labor, pricing, waste, taxes, proposal options, CRM quote generation, document generation, and electronic signatures.

The core of the project involved complex business rules, estimating calculations, Deluge development, API integrations, CRM data management, and process automation rather than basic forms and fields.

WNY Exteriors — Accounts Payable & Expense Management System

Developed a custom Zoho Creator accounts payable and expense management application to centralize material purchases, receipt processing, approvals, and reconciliation.

Purchase receipts and supporting documents uploaded to Zoho WorkDrive were automatically captured and converted into expense records in Zoho Creator. A centralized financial dashboard provided visibility into outstanding expenses, approval status, payment processing, and reconciliation.

The application enabled the accounting team to review source documents, classify and categorize expenses, validate transaction details, approve expenses, and maintain a complete audit trail. Once approved, transactions were automatically sent to QuickBooks for final accounting and payment processing.

Weston Dev — Loan Origination & Application Management System

Developed a custom Zoho Creator loan application and origination system for Carlyle Capital, integrated directly with Zoho CRM.

The application automatically retrieved and pre-populated borrower and deal information from CRM, reducing duplicate data entry and improving application accuracy. Based on the selected loan product, the system dynamically presented the appropriate application fields, requirements, and loan-specific information.

The solution supported 20+ loan products, each with its own application structure and data requirements. Once the loan request was completed, the application data was automatically synchronized back to Zoho CRM, providing the lending team with a centralized borrower and loan record.

Roadway Moving — Moving Operations & Fleet Availability Management

Developed two integrated Zoho Creator applications to manage moving operations and daily fleet capacity for a high-volume moving company operating 20–40 trucks per day.

The first application transformed confirmed Zoho CRM moving reservations into an operational scheduling system. Reservation and customer data flowed automatically from CRM into Zoho Creator, providing the operations team with a centralized daily dispatch calendar showing scheduled moves, trucks, and key job information.

The second application managed daily truck availability and fleet capacity. Operations staff could define truck availability through a calendar-based interface, and whenever a new moving reservation was created, the system automatically checked available capacity and adjusted truck availability accordingly.

Together, the applications connected sales reservations with real-time operational capacity, helping prevent overbooking and giving dispatch teams clear visibility into daily workloads and fleet utilization.

Key capabilities: Moving Reservations · Dispatch Scheduling · Fleet Management · Truck Availability · Capacity Planning · Automated Availability Checks · Calendar-Based Operations · Zoho CRM Integration · Zoho Creator
